test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'ensures'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context in the sentence is about the Ph.D. program and in particular, what it guarantees or establishes. 
 
• 'Ensures' means to make certain that something will occur or be the case. So, in this context, it would mean that the program makes certain that it provides a foundation for a fruitful research career.
 
• 'Ensures' provides a logical implication and makes the sentence coherent.
 
• Therefore, using 'ensures' makes the sentence read as "The programme ensures that it is not an end in itself, but a means for a fruitful research career," which interprets the intended meaning correctly.

**Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Decides': Usually pertains to making a choice, not a fit here as the programme doesn't make decisions.
 
• 'Mentions': Refers to referring to or citing something - it cannot be used in this context.
 
• 'Reflects': Although the program can reflect certain principles, the context here is about a certain provision or guarantee of the program, making 'ensures' a better fit.
